2610.08314.title: The Standardization Trap: Certifying Joint Label Processing in Tabular Foundation Models
2610.08314.paper_summary: Linear regression and kernel smoothing offer tractable explanations of in-context learning: in both, the features determine the weight assigned to each context label. However, whether this fixed-weight account describes pretrained tabular foundation models (TFMs) remains unclear. Testing this account using derivatives runs into a standardization trap: public TFM packages standardize the labels before the model sees them, yet ordinary derivatives also reflect behavior outside the set of standardized labels, making a model appear nonlinear even when every prediction it makes agrees with a fixed-weight map. We propose two certificates that depend only on predictions at standardized labels and can reject two distinct explanations: fixed-weight prediction and sums of independent nonlinear label transformations. Across the five public TFMs that we evaluate, our certificates show that changing one context label alters how other labels influence the prediction, a behavior we call joint processing. We further find that joint processing emerges with training and that attention scores carry most of the measured interaction. Together, these findings motivate TFM explanations that account for how context labels change the influence of individual examples.
2610.08314.paper_summary_zh: 線性回歸和核平滑提供了對上下文學習的可處理解釋：在這兩者中，特徵決定了分配給每個上下文標籤的權重。<lb/>然而，這種固定權重的解釋是否描述了預訓練的表格基礎模型（TFMs）仍然不清楚。<lb/>使用導數測試這種解釋會遇到標準化陷阱：公共TFM套件在模型看到標籤之前就對其進行標準化，然而普通的導數也反映了在標準化標籤集外的行為，使得模型即使在每個預測都與固定權重映射一致的情況下也顯得非線性。<lb/>我們提出了兩個證明，僅依賴於標準化標籤的預測，並且可以拒絕兩種不同的解釋：固定權重預測和獨立非線性標籤轉換的總和。<lb/>在我們評估的五個公共TFMs中，我們的證明顯示，改變一個上下文標籤會改變其他標籤對預測的影響，這種行為我們稱之為聯合處理。<lb/>我們進一步發現，聯合處理隨著訓練的進行而出現，且注意力分數承載了大部分測量到的互動。<lb/>綜合這些發現，促使我們對TFM的解釋考慮上下文標籤如何改變個別範例的影響。
